drivers.name: Security of user and payment data
drivers.description: User information, credentials, biometric data and payment information must be protected, including end-to-end encryption between user device and app database and compliance with ISO 27001.
supporting_evidence: quality_attributes.json: Security (high)
S1: 'secured with an end-to-end encryption of information between user device and app database'
Project description: 'ensure the security and privacy of user data, including payment information'
Project description: 'comply with the relevant security and data protection standards, such as ISO 27001'

drivers.name: GDPR and regional regulatory compliance
drivers.description: Processing of personal, biometric, location, payment and usage data must comply with GDPR, the Privacy Directive and the local EU or China standards that apply to the deployment location.
supporting_evidence: quality_attributes.json: Privacy and Regulatory Compliance (high)
Project description: 'comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Privacy Directive'
Project description: 'including EU or China standards, depending on the location of the university'
S3: 'flush out user thumb impression as soon as the user has been able to login'

drivers.name: Third-party payment platform integration
drivers.description: The system must work with a variety of third-party payment platforms and support bank account and debit/credit card payments for rental fees and overtime charges.
supporting_evidence: quality_attributes.json: Interoperability (high)
Project description: 'compatible with a variety of third-party payment platforms to allow users to pay for the bike rental fee seamlessly'
S8: 'pay via their bank account or by their debit/credit card'
S9: 'overtime rides are subject to additional charges'

drivers.name: Web and mobile client access
drivers.description: All biker functionality must be accessible from both web and mobile devices, despite device-dependent features such as biometric login, location and code scanning.
supporting_evidence: quality_attributes.json: Portability (multi-platform access) (high)
Project description: 'accessible through both web and mobile devices to maximize the availability of the service'
S3: 'by using their biometric thumb-impression'

drivers.name: Bike location and availability tracking
drivers.description: The system must track bike locations and availability, display available bikes within a radius around the biker (1000 m per project description, user-defined per S5), and reflect registration-driven availability changes for bikers and administrators.
supporting_evidence: Project description: 'capable of tracking and displaying the location of available bikes within a 1000-meter radius'
S5: 'view all of available bikes in close proximity defined by him/her'
S7: 'As soon as the bike is registered it must be removed from the list of available bikes'
S12: 'view all of the bikes in the city as available or under utilization'

drivers.name: Bike registration and unlocking
drivers.description: A biker must be able to register (and, per the project description, unlock) a physical bike by scanning a code or entering a four-digit code, which starts a rental.
supporting_evidence: S6: 'scan the code on bike scanner or by inputting the four digit code to register the bike'
Project description: 'unlocking them using a QR code'
requirements_analysis.json S6 implicit behavior (Inferred): the system must interact with the physical bike (or its lock)

drivers.name: Consistent bike and rental state
drivers.description: Bike availability, rental periods and charges must be correct and consistent, so a registered bike is not offered to others and overtime is charged accurately.
supporting_evidence: quality_attributes.json: Reliability (correctness of rental and bike state) (medium)
S7: 'it must be removed from the list of available bikes'
S9: 'Any overtime rides are subject to additional charges'

drivers.name: Rental lifecycle timing
drivers.description: Rentals of specific minutes, a day or up to a week must be tracked over time, with a notification X minutes before expiry and overtime charges after it, independently of the biker's 15-minute app session.
supporting_evidence: S10: 'rent a bike for specific minutes, a day or for a week at maximum'
S9: 'notify the biker X minutes prior to the expiry of their rental time'
S4: 'after an inactivity of 15 minutes'
quality_attributes.json: Performance (timeliness) (medium)

drivers.name: Biker authentication and session management
drivers.description: Registration with verification code, login by email/password or biometric thumb-impression, and logout on demand or after 15 minutes of inactivity.
supporting_evidence: S2: 'verification code via an SMS or email'
S3: 'login to the app via their email and password or by using their biometric thumb-impression'
S4: 'logged out ... after an inactivity of 15 minutes'

drivers.name: External SMS and email delivery
drivers.description: Verification codes must be delivered via SMS or email, which depends on messaging channels outside the system.
supporting_evidence: S2: 'The app must sent a verification code via an SMS or email'
quality_attributes.json: Interoperability (high), messaging part strongly implied

drivers.name: Usage history and administrative reporting
drivers.description: Rental records must support biker usage history (view and download, last 3 months) and administrator fleet-wide status views and hourly/daily usage.
supporting_evidence: S11: 'view and download their bike usage history up to last 3 months'
S12: 'view all of the bikes in the city as available or under utilization'
S13: 'hourly and daily usage of the bikes'

drivers.name: Usability for all riders
drivers.description: The application must be user-friendly and easy to use for all potential riders, including finding and navigating to bikes.
supporting_evidence: quality_attributes.json: Usability (medium)
Project description: 'user-friendly and easy to use for all potential riders'
S6: 'App must help the biker to navigate to the available bike'

drivers.name: Changeability of payment options and regulations
drivers.description: Payment methods and platforms, and the applicable regional regulations, are expected to vary or change.
supporting_evidence: quality_attributes.json: Modifiability (medium)
S8: 'Currently cash payments are not supported'
Project description: 'EU or China standards, depending on the location of the university'

drivers.name: Permitted technology context
drivers.description: The project description states that the design 'can rely on' a container orchestration platform, service registry and discovery, API gateway, message broker and distributed tracing. This is a permission, not a mandate; it limits the technology context but does not require any of these.
supporting_evidence: Project description: 'The design of the system can rely on the following tools and technologies: container orchestration platform, service registry and discovery, API gateway, message broker, and distributed tracing.'

drivers.name: Sustainable mobility goal
drivers.description: The software should be designed to minimize the carbon footprint and promote sustainable mobility; no measurable target is given.
supporting_evidence: quality_attributes.json: Sustainability (low)
Project description: 'designed to minimize the carbon footprint and promote sustainable mobility'
